answers.rationale: Protein up and replicated in all cohorts. RCC has the top transcript share and the purity bound is above 0. The protein is internal, liver IHC level is 3, and there are no ccRCC dependent lines. No verdict rule beyond needs_more_data applies.

Protein is up and RNA replicated in TCGA. CD8_T share (0.533) exceeds RCC (0.345), so not tumour-intrinsic. The surface call is surface. IHC was not measured and the proteome shows no enrichment. DepMap has no dependent lines. Infiltration signal.

Protein up, replicated, tumour-intrinsic and surface. Stomach IHC level is 3 and the proteome is vital-enriched, so there is a safety concern and the surface candidate rule fails. No ccRCC dependent lines.

Protein is down, and RNA is down in CPTAC, TCGA and confirmatory protein, so replicated. The purity bound is below 0, so tumour origin is not established. There is no surface record for the target. The proteome reports vital enrichment. No dependency. Loss biomarker.
